mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, sec.Sec_Name as secName, c1.C_Name as glsWarranteeName, c2.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, c3.C_Name as glbCompanyName, c1.C_Abbreviation as glsWarranteeAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as glbCompanyAbbName, d.D_name as pCompetentDepartmentName, gls.Gls_Code as glsCode, gls.Gls_Type as glsType, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, panya.c_name as companyPartyAName, panyb.c_name as companyPartybName, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, mn.* from Guarantee_Letter_Back mn left join Guarantee_Letter_Sign gls on gls.Gls_Id=mn.Gls_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=gls.P_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=gls.Sec_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=gls.Con_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on gls.Gls_Warrantee=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on pro.P_Construction_Unit=c2.C_Id left join SYS_Department d on pro.P_Competent_Department=d.D_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on mn.Glb_Company_Id=c3.C_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Glb_Id left join sys_company panya ON con.Con_Party_A_Id = panya.c_id left join sys_company panyb ON con.Con_Party_B_Id = panyb.c_id where mn.Glb_Id=#{glbId}
